chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Musa ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no Itikaaf except with Fasting'.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Itikaaf to be valid according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) specifies fasting as a requisite condition for the validity of Itikaaf, distinguishing it from mere residence in the mosque. This ruling reflects the scholarly consensus that Itikaaf is an act of worship (*ibadah*) requiring the spiritual discipline of fasting to enhance devotion and focus during the period of seclusion.
